prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: neck and back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1125; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] at a controlled intersection. Our client was proceeding through the intersection on a green signal when your insured drove into the side of our client's vehicle after failing to yield the right of way. The force of the impact spun our client's car partially around and caused the driver's head and torso to be thrown against the restraint system.

Our client was taken from the scene and evaluated for pain. Diagnostic follow-up has confirmed a cervical strain and a lumbar strain. Our client has undergone a course of physical therapy and has been advised to limit lifting and prolonged sitting. Ongoing stiffness and headaches have interfered with work duties and routine household activities.

Liability in this matter is clear. The police report and the independent witness statement both place fault with your insured for entering the intersection against the signal. We see no reasonable basis for disputing responsibility.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
